verdict.rationale: Digits documents dimensional accounting and reporting on higher tiers, which covers the class/tag dimension part of the story, and its API can fetch the full chart of accounts. Nothing in the evidence shows accountants can create or edit accounts, set account types, or build sub-account hierarchies. missing for 10: documented chart-of-accounts editing, account type configuration, sub-account hierarchy support, detail on how class/tag dimensions are defined, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions
